Standardgenvejen er Shift + P. Den virke: The default shortcut is Shift + P. It is disabled in text fields and open dialogs. Clear the field to disable it.
Lokal tekstimport. Overskrifter, tekst o: Local text import preserves headings, text and simple lists/tables. Use visual import for pictures and page layout. Office animations are not imported.
HUWiki-format bevarer slideindstillinger: HUWiki format preserves slide settings and notes. Existing content with the same title is reused only if identical.
Layoutet er valgt. Slides med standardvi: Layout selected. Slides using the default design follow it; individual slide choices are preserved.
Konverteret lokalt med LibreOffice. Kont: Converted locally with LibreOffice. Check fonts, layout and page breaks in the preview. Office animations and speaker notes are not imported.
